answer: Agents start their voyage by locking 400 POA in escrow for 20 epochs, referral links on a crystal-clear graph. Newcomers also need a referrer staking 200 POA; if one proves fake, both deposits are slashed. Peers dispute fakes with evidence; a jury of 7 confirms them. 100 fakes cost 60,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 400 once and keeps earning; the lagoon stays deep, and bought accounts fail: the graph exposes one referrer.
